items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: And my band, like... It was John Collins, Harold West, Gabby(?), Chuck and myself.

ctx.x: And the man came back, and he called me... He talked to the other guys first. He said, "You're the leader, right?" I said, "Yeah." He said, "Did you pay your guys last night?" I said, "Yeah." He said, "Well, how much money would you say your piano had?" I said, "I know what he had. I know what I gave him last night. When we checked out, he couldn't have no more than (?)." So he said, "Well, it's too bad, because he just robbed the Post Office." I said, "What?!"

And my band, like... It was John Collins, Harold West, Gabby(?), Chuck and myself. Well, the four of us wanted... thought, "Please put us in the cell with him" -- because we was guilty! Now I'm worried about the car, right? So I said, "Well, we didn't know anything about that."
